history.summary: A 667 sqft 1BR at Park Colonial (Woodleigh), $1.22M / $1,829 PSF, directly above Woodleigh MRT (370m). A reputable, newer (2022) leasehold project with reliable +3.57%/yr appreciation over 220 transactions and a doorstep MRT — a solid, liquid 1BR with a defensible value case.
history.rating_rationale: 370m to Woodleigh MRT (NE line, direct to CBD) is a prime transit location that underpins rental and resale demand. URA +3.57%/yr is reliable (220 txns), and at $1,829 PSF the 1BR sits well under the $2,332 blended project median (1BRs run higher PSF than the median, so part of this is mix, but it remains a fair entry). New-ish 2022 build means minimal maintenance and a long 99yr lease. Quantum $1.22M is liquid for a city-fringe 1BR.
red_flags: $1,829 PSF is a high absolute PSF for a 1BR — buyer must rely on continued city-fringe demand
1BR is niche for own-stay; investment-grade but tenant-dependent
D13 had heavy new 1BR supply (Bartley/Woodleigh cluster) — watch rental competition
catalysts: 370m to Woodleigh MRT (NE line) — doorstep transit
Bidadari estate maturation and Woodleigh Mall integration

history.summary: A 667 sqft (2+study format) unit at Woodleigh MRT asking $1,829 psf against a verified project average of ~$2,289 psf and 667-sqft comps near ~$2,541 psf — a large, real-looking discount in a strong RCR-adjacent location, though the size/bed label warrants a viewing.
history.rating_rationale: Verified comps make the cheapness credible: 463 sqft 1BRs trade $2,030-$2,376 psf and 667 sqft units near $2,541 psf, so asking $1,829 psf is well under the cohort and the algo's psf_premium_vs_cohort of -20.2% is plausible rather than a one-comp fluke (psf_cohort_txns=26, appreciation_txns=220 are reasonably deep). Park Colonial sits 50m from Woodleigh MRT in the Bidadari estate (D13), a desirable RCR-ish location with realized forward returns (~+3.5%) far above CCR. The $1.22M quantum is liquid. The 667 sqft listed as '1 bed' is really a 2+study format — verify the actual config and whether the discount reflects a low floor, poor facing, or tenancy.
red_flags: 667 sqft labeled 1-bed is actually the 2+study type — confirm config and reason for the steep discount
A ~20% gap below cohort PSF can signal a problem unit (low floor/west sun/tenanted) as easily as a bargain
catalysts: 50m sheltered walk to Woodleigh MRT (NEL) in maturing Bidadari estate
Verified discount of ~$700 psf vs same-size comps if the unit is sound
D13/RCR realized forward returns materially exceed CCR under v3.4 priors
